title: koeleria spicata subsp. geghamensis
intro: Koeleria spicata subsp. geghamensis, commonly known as Gegham's hair-grass, is a type of grass species in the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Gegham's hair-grass include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
